name: Brook Eshcol
line: The Valley of Eshcol was a valley in Canaan where Israel's spies cut a huge cluster of grapes, and it was named for that cluster.

moments.title: The giant cluster of grapes
moments.text: The spies cut a branch with one cluster of grapes, and two men carried it on a pole. They also took pomegranates and figs, and the place was named the Valley of Eshcol for the cluster.

moments.title: Spying out the land
moments.text: Moses later recalled that the twelve spies went up into the hill country and came to the Valley of Eshcol. There they spied out the land and took some of its fruit.

moments.title: Seeing the land at Eshcol
moments.text: Moses later said the spies went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land. Then they discouraged Israel from entering the land the LORD had given them.
